g.aria-label: We stand here among loved ones and lush nature and in the moment we make promises we have the power to make. I promise to take a step back often in the moments we create together and really take it all in. Just like this one. I promise to continue to make silly faces always in pictures with you if you give me a smile every now and then. I promise to find appreciation throughout changes we face, small or substantial. I promise to see this through with you, come what may. I promise to always be rooting you on, just as you do for me. We can make our impact on this world together and I promise to walk by your side, arms linked and in step, as we do. I promise we both will mess up, and we’ll create a masterpiece of love and effort through our lifetime together.
